_about: Public-domain William Ralph Inge (1860-1954, Dean of St Paul's) for the Word Hoard: The Victorian Age (1922) from Project Gutenberg and 17 books printed before 1930 from Internet Archive scans, among them Christian Mysticism (Bampton Lectures, 1899), Studies of English Mystics (1906), Personal Idealism and Mysticism (1907), The Philosophy of Plotinus (2 vols, 1918), the two series of Outspoken Essays (1919, 1922) and The Platonic Tradition in English Religious Thought (1926). Written in English; his later books are not here. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
